## Verified notes

`PIPE_PHASE` is the authoritative phase field and accepts **any** string with a 200, leaving the derived `PHASE_AID` stale — the client is the only validation. Never write `PHASE_AID` directly. A collection filter such as `$filter=TAEMPs/any(...)` returns a 500 on this build; query the child entity separately.
